span.p:
AP3 — [device-bridge] (#183, [device-shell-tool] 0→42) —
a NEW CLASS of local execution that bypasses the local
permission system

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(248, 250, 252) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local CLI opens an OUTBOUND WSS to
bridge.claudeusercontent.com/devices/{org}_{acct}/{dev}/bridge
and runs an MCP SERVER over it.
The CLOUD session is the client

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
[device-shell-tool]: shell on the user's LOCAL machine,
bash -c, 45s cap, max 4 concurrent.
Output returns to the CLOUD session's model,
NOT the local one

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
KEY FACT: dispatches straight into the low-level shell
executor. NO canUseTool, NO permission-mode, NO
allow/deny
rules, NO local PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks.
There is no local agent loop on this path

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Substituted control: the OS sandbox, failing CLOSED at
six
checkpoints — unavailable (the stock default),
unsupported,
failed-to-start, unconfined, allows-unix-sockets,
injects-credentials. The last two are anti-pivot guards

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INERT on a stock install: explicit --remote/--cloud,
plus
tengu_[remote-backend-gate] AND
tengu_[device-bridge-gate] (both default
FALSE), an org policy that fails closed, a signed EC
P-256
device bind whose echo the client verifies, and a
sandbox
settings opt-in that is off by default

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Asymmetry: --permission-mode is NOT forwarded to cloud
sessions, so the local user's mode choice does not
constrain the cloud session driving [device-shell-tool]
